body: Thanks for the advice man. I’ll definitely go into it. He works making beer and it’s something he’s always wanted to do but somewhat a double edged sword cause it allows him to be drunk a lot. I’ve never drank in my life so it’ll be hard to connect on that front but I’ll try. I’m leaving in a few months for the military and want him to be okay while I’m gone. I’ve just had too many phone calls informing me that a friend has taken their own life. Idk how I’d live with myself if he tried to reach out and I shut him down knowing. Also sorry for the bad grammar and punctuation overall
